intl_finance.document: Bank statement or certificate (finances), requested only if admitted and enrolling; no bank statement is needed at the time of application
intl_finance.notes: Separate from proof of funds: non-U.S. citizens who cannot pay the full cost of attendance must submit the CSS Profile (or the ISAFA if the $25 fee is a hardship) by the application deadline (Early Decision I Nov 1; Early Decision II or Regular Decision Jan 15). The admissions requirements page also names a Lehigh Certificate of Finances form for those who will need aid. Lehigh is need-aware for non-U.S. citizens. No date or form details for the post-admission bank statement are published.

notes: Lehigh's official requirements page lists 'Common Application or Coalition Application with Scoir with Lehigh Questions and Writing Supplement' as a first-year requirement, so a writing supplement exists, but no official Lehigh page or public Common App page read here gives the 2026-27 prompt text, word limits or required/optional status (the prompts appear only inside the application). Third-party guides were not used. Check the Common App or Coalition application for the exact questions.
